description: Recorded LLM output for offline fallback. Auto-generated incident summary for the Harbourfront One L23 chilled-water leak incident room.

summary.headline: Chilled-water leak from AHU-23-01 supply branch above L22 bank tenant ceiling; water within 1.5 m of DB-23A; re-energisation blocked pending LEW sign-off.
summary.location: L23 ceiling void / CHW riser R2 branch, above L22 tenant ceiling
summary.timeline_summary: At 08:02 the iBMS leak detector LD-23-04 triggered, followed by an AHU-23-01 chilled-water delta-T anomaly and a tenant call from the bank facilities desk. A P1 CMMS work order was raised. The on-site technician identified the source as a CHW supply branch coupling at AHU-23-01 and observed water tracking toward Distribution Board DB-23A (within 1.5 m). The isolation sub-valve ISV-L23-CHW was closed at 08:09, stopping the flow. The MOSAIC engine triggered Rule TS-07 (v1.2), blocking re-energisation of the AHU/DB circuit. The Duty LEW was dispatched at 08:14 with ETA 08:39. An insulation resistance test is pending LEW arrival. The AOM is drafting the first-notice tenant message within the 30-minute SLA window.

key_decisions.text: Re-energisation of AHU-23-01 / DB-23A circuit blocked. Missing evidence: LEW sign-off, insulation resistance test, area dry. LEW Rahul Menon dispatched.
Chilled-water source isolated at sub-valve ISV-L23-CHW at 08:09 (7 minutes from alarm). Branch isolation only — riser R2 left open.
First-notice tenant message drafting. 30-min SLA clock started at 08:04 (tenant call). Deadline: 08:34.

summary.current_risk: Water stopped but DB-23A area moisture elevated (18% vs 12% baseline). No water inside switchroom. Risk of escalation to building-wide power outage if moisture reaches switchgear before LEW inspects.
